summary.text: Kevin Waters is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 17-Position 1, in office since January 9, 2023, and he is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Ben Christly.
A business owner and economic development manager for Skamania County, he previously served as a Port of Skamania commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Waters was born in Portland, Oregon, graduated from Stevenson High School and earned a bachelor's degree in public relations, advertising and applied communications from Eastern Washington University in 2008, according to Ballotpedia.
His House Republican biography says he has lived in Southwest Washington his entire life and started his family's business, Backwoods Brewing, which grew to more than 70 employees.
It says he was a Port of Skamania commissioner from 2010 to 2019 and is economic development manager for Skamania County and executive director of the Skamania Economic Development Council.
Waters succeeded Republican Vicki Kraft in the 17th District seat.

His biography says he is a former corrections officer and the ranking Republican on the State Government and Tribal Relations Committee, and that he also serves on the Capital Budget, Rules, and Technology, Economic Development and Veterans committees.
